bio_en: Sahak Ter-Tovmasian was born in 1892 in Shatakh (Jermadzor), a half-Armenian village south of Lake Van that produced many fedayi and intellectuals. He began his schooling in Van but events forced him to leave it unfinished; self-educated, he took part in the intellectual movement of Shatakh, whose awakening alarmed the Van governor Jevdet bey. He later worked closely with Simon Vratsian and other ARF leaders in exile. He died on 18 March 1960.
